# SkyQuest Technology Consulting

> An integrated strategy, technology and impact consulting firm helping
> businesses and governments achieve sustainable growth. SkyQuest builds
> satellite, AI and data platforms across agriculture, mining, infrastructure,
> diagnostics, climate finance and public health, and delivers advisory and
> programme-management services alongside them.

SkyQuest operates across 12+ countries with 200+ engagements delivered. The
sections below point to the canonical pages for each platform, capability and
industry practice.

## Products

- [Products overview](https://www.skyquestt.com/products): All seven SkyQuest platforms, each built around a specific development challenge.
- [AgriMap](https://www.skyquestt.com/products/agrimap): Seed intelligence platform giving agriculture departments, banks and governments a real-time view of seed replacement rates, crop health and variety adoption down to the block level.
- [Inspect Global](https://www.skyquestt.com/products/inspectglobal): Fuses satellite, GPS, drones, IoT and AI into one verified record of project progress, risk and compliance for infrastructure owners, lenders and programme auditors.
- [MineralIQ](https://www.skyquestt.com/products/mineraliq): Satellite-powered mining intelligence for governments, regulators, mining companies, investors and artisanal cooperatives — covering cadastre, compliance, production and environmental risk.
- [SkyQuest Labs](https://www.skyquestt.com/products/sqlabs): Tele-pathology platform connecting diagnostic labs to remote pathologists, delivering verified reports in under 15 minutes. Only data travels, never the sample.
- [DeCarbonX](https://www.skyquestt.com/products/decarbonx): Sovereign climate finance platform turning climate project ideas into finance-ready instruments, with digital MRV and national data sovereignty (Article 6, NDC 3.0).
- [AlwaysOn](https://www.skyquestt.com/products/alwayson): WhatsApp-native health service delivery with AI-assisted symptom assessment, multilingual support and rapid expert referral.
- [AgriPath](https://www.skyquestt.com/products/agripath): Takes any agri-technology from a technology profile to a scored, regulation-ready market entry plan across 90+ countries in Africa and Asia.
